newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee jobless rate rises to 4.9 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee jobless rate rises to 4.9 pct in October.

text.p: Tennessee's unemployement rate rose to 4.9 percent in October from 4.5 percent in September, acting Employment Security Commissioner Hazel Albert said Wednesday.
Despite the slight increase, Albert said the state's jobless rate had stayed below 5 percent for seven consecutive months, indicating Tennessee's employment picture was solid.
For the six-county Knoxville metropolitan area, the October jobless rate rose to 3.3 percent in October from 3.1 percent in September.

Statewide employment in the wholesale trade sector reached a record 145,400 in October. Business services totalled 144,600 jobs while transportation, public utilities and communications climbed to 138,000. Tourism-related industries lost jobs while local education had gains.
Seventeen counties had lower unemployment rates in October, 74 had higher rates and four were uncahnged.

Among large metropolitan counties, unemployment rates in Davidson and Knox both rose to 3 percent in October from 2.8 percent in September. Hamilton County's jobless rate rose to 3.7 percent in October from 3.5 percent in Septemver, and Shelby County's rose to 4.2 percent in October from 3.9 percent in September.
